title: Publish your own books on Amazon KDP, using AI only within its rules
audience: Writers and subject experts who already write their own material and want to publish through KDP.
summary: Write your own books, use AI tools to edit and refine them, and publish through KDP while following its AI-content disclosure rules. The source gives no income figure, and results vary.
workflow_steps: Choose a topic you can write about yourself, and avoid copyrighted material that is freely available on the web
Write the content yourself; if you use AI only to edit, refine or error-check it, KDP calls that AI-assisted
If an AI tool created any text, images or translations, note it so you can disclose it to KDP when you publish or republish
Read KDP's content guidelines, including the section on poor customer experience, before you upload
Create a KDP account and publish the book, answering the AI-content question truthfully
Check the live book page and fix any problems you find
tools_and_prompts: An AI assistant for editing, with a prompt such as: point out unclear sentences and suggest edits, but keep my wording

income.basis: No income figure appears in the source; it covers rules, not earnings. Results vary.

time_to_first_result: Varies; not stated in the source
risks: AI-generated text, images or translations must be disclosed to KDP; AI-assisted editing does not need to be
Copyrighted content that is freely available on the web is not accepted
KDP's guidelines include a section on poor customer experience, so low-quality books may be refused
Sales are not guaranteed and may be zero
Rules can change, so re-read the guidelines before each upload
